entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Instinctive, seemingly human creatures that transform into bloodthirsty wolf-like beasts, found on Innistrad, Dominaria, Ulgrotha and Eldraine.

entities.name: Krallenhorde
entities.description: Innistrad's largest howlpack, led by Ulrich, which survived the Cursemute intact.

entities.name: Ulrich
entities.description: A werewolf who leads the Krallenhorde and stays with the wolves even in human form.

entities.name: Mondronen howlpack
entities.description: A howlpack of about sixty known for dark magic, dissolved after Avacyn's return.

entities.name: Leeraug howlpack
entities.description: A small vicious howlpack that hunted under the new moon, dissolved after Avacyn's return.

entities.name: Vildin howlpack
entities.description: An infamous howlpack that admits only humans who murdered before becoming werewolves.

entities.name: Wolfir
entities.description: Noble creatures made when Avacyn fused repentant werewolves' two aspects; the change mostly reversed when she was corrupted.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel who offered repentant werewolves a place at her side and transformed them into wolfir.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker through whose machinations Avacyn was corrupted.

entities.name: Silverfurs
entities.description: A virtuous howlpack of surviving wolfir led by Johanna and Pavel.

entities.name: Johanna
entities.description: A wolfir who co-leads the Silverfurs.

entities.name: Pavel
entities.description: A wolfir who co-leads the Silverfurs.

entities.name: Dronepack
entities.description: A group of werewolves warped by Emrakul that hunted in the Somberwald after Avacyn's death.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi whose corruption warped werewolves' dual natures.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A werewolf leader whose heavy hitters are the dire-strain werewolves.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: The ruler of the Dark Barony on Ulgrotha who made the first greater werewolf.

entities.name: Syr Armont
entities.description: A knight who investigated and broke the werefox curse of Redtooth Keep.

entities.name: Redtooth Keep
entities.description: An Eldraine keep whose elves were cursed to become werefoxes at night.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The Innistrad province where werewolves prowl.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane where werewolves are most prominent.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane where greater werewolves originated.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: A group whose resistance included a few wolfir.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: An event on Innistrad that the Krallenhorde survived and after which the Vildin howlpack appeared.

events.summary: A witch curses the elves of Redtooth Keep for denying hospitality to travelers, making them werefoxes at night.
events.quote: elves of Redtooth Keep were cursed by a witch for denying hospitality to a group of travelers

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Syr Armont investigates and breaks the curse.
events.quote: Syr Armont traveled to Readtooth Keep to investigate and eventually broke the curse

events.summary: Emrakul's corruption warps werewolves until the more corrupted side takes over and they can no longer transform.
events.quote: the more corrupted side took over, and the werewolves lost their ability to transform at all

events.summary: The Krallenhorde survives the Cursemute intact.
events.quote: The Krallenhorde survived the Cursemute intact.

events.summary: After Avacyn's return the Mondronen howlpack is dissolved.
events.quote: After the return of Avacyn, the howlpack was dissolved.

events.summary: Avacyn offers repentant werewolves a place at her side and transforms them into the wolfir.
events.quote: Avacyn offered repentant humans afflicted by the lycanthropic curse a special place at her side

events.summary: The transformation is mostly reversed when Avacyn is corrupted through Nahiri's machinations.
events.quote: The transformation was mostly reversed when Avacyn was corrupted through the machinations of Nahiri

events.summary: After Avacyn's death the Somberwald becomes a hunting ground for the Emrakul-warped Dronepack.
events.quote: the Somberwald became a hunting ground for the Dronepack

events.summary: On Ulgrotha Baron Sengir punishes a corrupt wizard savant by making him the first greater werewolf.
events.quote: was made into the first greater werewolf as punishment by Baron Sengir
